message: You know that one friend who always panics at the slightest hint of rain? Well, I like to think I’m the calm one in the group. A little preparedness goes a long way, and it doesn’t hurt to be informed about what to do during a storm. I recently found a handy resource that covers flood safety tips—because you never know when Mother Nature might decide to throw a tantrum! Have you ever had to deal with unexpected weather? 🌧️
